purpose: Remeasure the E10g balanced safety-action guard on DEV + VALIDATION after DEV-only acceptance, without using VALIDATION for tuning.

background.e10d_full_result: Improved average task quality but introduced premature_action_rate=0.25.
background.e10e_full_result: Unchanged from E10d full; premature_action_rate remained 0.25.
background.e10f_dev_result: Safety preserved but action/decision overblocked on DEV.
background.e10g_dev_result: DEV-only safety/action target met with real_task_quality=1.0 and premature_action_rate=0.0.

measurement_rules: Run DEV + VALIDATION only after E10g DEV-only acceptance.
Do not tune on VALIDATION before, during, or after this measurement.

Do not expose private expected paths, evaluator labels, reference trajectories, validation feedback, docs/test-scenarios.md, data/cases.parquet, eval/expected-paths.json, or LOCKED_TEST to the model or guard.
Score with E9 v3 only after fixed outputs are generated.
Commit only sanitized aggregate summaries and reports.
